create_llm_prefix_caching: create an LLM instance with prefix caching enabled for optimized repeated prompt generation
create_sampling_params: create a SamplingParams object with temperature set to zero for deterministic text generation
run_llm_generate: run LLM.generate with multiple prompts sharing a common prefix and sampling parameters
run_llm_warmup: run LLM.generate with a single prompt to warm up the shared prefix KV cache before batch generation
run_cleanup_dist_env: run cleanup_dist_env_and_memory to destroy the LLM object and free GPU memory
